author: Ribose Inc.
description: Coridoc provides a hub-and-spoke architecture for document transformations. The CoreModel serves as the canonical, format-agnostic representation, enabling transformations between AsciiDoc, HTML, Markdown, and more.

author: Ribose Inc.
description: AsciiDoc Document Model, Parser, and Serializer for the Coridoc document transformation framework. Provides bidirectional transformation between AsciiDoc and CoreModel.

author: Ribose Inc.
description: Provides Markdown parsing and serialization capabilities for Coridoc. Includes the Markdown Document Model, a CommonMark-compliant Parsanol-based parser, and round-trip capable serializer.

author: Ribose Inc.
description: Provides OOXML (DOCX) to CoreModel transformation for the Coridoc document transformation hub. Uses Uniword to read DOCX files and transforms the OOXML model tree to Coridoc::CoreModel.

author: Ribose Inc.
description: Transforms Coridoc CoreModel documents into ProseMirror-compatible JSON/YAML suitable for rich frontend rendering with Vue.js, React, or any ProseMirror-based editor.

author: Ribose Inc.
description: Provides HTML to AsciiDoc conversion and AsciiDoc to HTML rendering with both classic and modern Vue.js SPA themes
